about.title: About Us
about.value1Desc: Book with us and pay less than on Booking or Airbnb. The price you see is the real price, no surprises.
about.value2Desc: We talk with you before, during and after your stay. No bots, no endless forms.
about.value3Desc: We are from Ribadeo and know the area like no one else. We give you real recommendations on where to eat and what to see.
about.heroDesc: We are a local family with eight apartments facing the Eo estuary. We decided to do without intermediaries to offer you a fair price and direct treatment.
about.storyText1: It all started with a single apartment facing the estuary that my grandfather rehabilitated in the 80s. Over time, the family grew and so did the number of floor. Today there are eight, but the spirit is the same: to offer visitors the same authentic experience we have when we look at the Eo from the window.
about.storyText2: Ribadeo is a special place. The estuary, the international bridge, the lighthouse island, As Catedrais 20 minutes away. The afternoon light in summer painting the waters golden. The octopus 'a feira' in the port stalls. We want you to experience it as we do, and not to cost you an arm and a leg.
about.storyText3: We've been on Booking for years because it gave us visibility. But we got tired of seeing how they charged our guests between 15 and 20% commission. This website is our answer.
about.locationDetail: In the northeastern extreme of Galicia, on the border with Asturias, on the edge of the Eo estuary.
about.ribadeoDesc1: Ribadeo is the gateway to the Galician Green Coast. 20 minutes from the beaches of As Catedrais, 30 from Luarca and 1 hour from Lugo. A perfect starting point for exploring the Mariña lucense.
about.ribadeoDesc2: The historical center, the maritime walk, the yacht club, the viewpoints over the estuary, local markets and the best seafood restaurants in the region are just a few minutes walk away.
about.ctaDesc: Check availability and book directly. No commissions, with personal treatment and the best price guaranteed.
about.experienceRibadeo: What to see near Illa Pancha
about.expDesc1: From Ribadeo, the Mariña Lucense and western Asturias are right at your doorstep. Here are some essentials.
about.expDesc2: Craft markets, music festivals, hiking through the Mariña lucense or surfing on the best beaches in the north.

experiences.heroDesc: A guide to discovering the Mariña Lucense and western Asturias.
experiences.introText1: Ribadeo sits right on the border between Galicia and Asturias, on the Cantabrian Green Coast. From our apartments you can explore two regions with their own identity in less than an hour by car.
experiences.introText2: Here are the spots we recommend to our guests: beaches, villages, lighthouses, viewpoints and food gems. All within easy reach.
experiences.marinaDesc: Legendary cliffs, pristine beaches and seafaring villages that keep the Galician soul alive. Perfect for nature, food and heritage lovers.
experiences.asturiasDesc: Cross the Puente de los Santos bridge into Asturias: white-washed villages, postcard fishing towns, dramatic cliffs and the best cider on the Cantabrian.
experiences.mapTitle: The whole region at a glance
experiences.mapDesc: Ribadeo is a perfect base: in less than 1 hour you reach As Catedrais, Cudillero, Lugo and Luarca.
experiences.ctaDesc: Book your apartment at Illa Pancha and start exploring the best coast in northern Spain.

marinaPoi.desc: The most photogenic lighthouse on the Cantabrian, on a small island linked by a footbridge. Unforgettable sunsets.
Plaza de España, indiano mansions, colonial palaces and viewpoints over the Eo estuary. Perfect to wander and try octopus.
Natural Heritage. Arches and vaults carved by the sea on slate cliffs. Book in advance during high season to access the sand.
Lively fishing town with a wide dune beach perfect for surfing and families.
Former capital of the Kingdom of Galicia. Basilica cathedral, arcaded square and traditional bakeries. An inland gem.
Elevated viewpoint above the Mariña lucense coastline with panoramic views of the Cantabrian Sea. Ideal for admiring the coast from the heights.
Walled historic centre and the most famous Holy Week in the north. Gateway to the western Mariña.
The least crowded part of As Catedrais Beach, only accessible at low tide. Rocky formations that resemble stacked sheets of paper shaped by the sea.
Coastal town in the Mariña lucense with quiet beaches and natural surroundings. Known for its crystal-clear waters and whale watching in spring.
Spectacular headland with vertiginous views over the Cantabrian cliffs. One of the most dramatic and least crowded landscapes on the Galician coast.
UNESCO World Heritage. The only Roman wall in the world preserved along its full perimeter: 2 km you can walk on top.

asturiasPoi.desc: The iconic bridge over the Eo estuary linking Galicia and Asturias. A must-see viewpoint at sunset.
The white village of Asturias. Whitewashed houses, viewpoint with the best views over the estuary and a square with the oldest cypress in Spain.
Surf mecca of the north. Lighthouse, beaches for all levels and an authentic seafaring centre.
Wild and uncrowded beach surrounded by Asturian meadows. Excellent for surfing and those seeking peace away from the crowds.
Beautiful fishing village declared a Historic Artistic Site. Picturesque harbour, indiano mansions and an urban beach perfect for a stroll.
White-washed fishing town with a panoramic cemetery, seven bridges and an urban beach. Try the catch of the day.
Former railway line converted into a green trail running along the Asturian coast between cliffs and little-known beaches. Accessible for the whole family.
Small municipality in western Asturias known for its artisan knifemakers. Start of the Mills Route and an example of authentic rural tourism.
Vertigo cliffs and one of the most spectacular lighthouses on the Cantabrian. Whale watching point in spring.
Three municipalities (Santa Eulalia, San Martín and Villanueva de Oscos) in a pristine Asturian interior. Folk architecture, nature and sustainable rural tourism.
Wild cove surrounded by vertical cliffs and small islets. The geological paradise of western Asturias.
The most photographed fishing village in Spain. Colourful houses cascading down a sea ravine. Arrive early.
